title-group.article-title: Spatial profiling of tumours with a multiplexed assay

article-meta.aff: 2Department of Genetics, Example University, Boston, MA, USA

fn.p: J.D. is an employee of 10x Genomics. R.R. has received research support from Illumina.

sec.title: Library preparation and sequencing
sec.p: Libraries were prepared with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' v3.1 kit (10x Genomics) and sequenced on a NovaSeq X Plus (Illumina). Spatial data were generated with Xenium In Situ. Chromium was quantified separately as a metal control.

sec.title: Proteomics
sec.p: Peptides were analysed on an Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer coupled to an Evosep One. The G4 quadruplex assay was not used.

sec.title: Data availability
sec.p: Sequencing data are in GEO under GSE000001.
